title: Bedtime Routine Adherence
dataSources: Baby feeds (`baby:feed`), baby sleep (`baby:sleep`), diaper changes (`diaper:change`), chore completions (`chore:completion`), allowance ledger (`allowance:ledger`), family calendar (`family:calendar`), growth measurements (`growth:measurement`).
app: Baby-tracking apps (Huckleberry/Baby Daybook exports), chore and allowance boards, shared family calendars, and growth logs — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=baby:sleep event=bedtime
| eval target=1230, actual=strftime(_time,"%H%M"), late=if(actual>2100,1,0)
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(late) as late_nights, count as nights by _time
| eval on_time_pct=round(100*(nights-late_nights)/nights)
description: Tracks how consistently the kids actually got to bed on time each week, the quiet foundation of a calmer household.
value: Consistent bedtimes improve everyone's mood and sleep; measuring adherence keeps the routine honest when life gets busy.
implementation: Log bedtimes to `index=personal`; schedule weekly and review on-time nights.
visualization: Column chart of on-time bedtime percentage per week.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks how often the children actually got to bed on time, which makes for a calmer home.
